tour.shortcuts_blurb: A few of the ways power users get around Moosewave.
tour.settings_replay_blurb: Want a refresher on the dashboard? The product tour walks through the major surfaces in under two minutes.
tour.marketing_hero_body: Let's take the scenic route — 90 seconds, tops. We'll show you what makes this different.
tour.marketing_migrate_body: Mailchimp, Substack, Beehiiv, ConvertKit, ActiveCampaign, and CSV paths bring source-supported subscribers and tags. Paid Stripe subscriptions move only on supported source-bound paths; Substack and Beehiiv premium metadata is evidence, not billing migration. Automations translate only where safe; otherwise Moosewave preserves rebuild evidence.
tour.marketing_inbox_body: Inbox Reality predicts placement and, when controlled testing is enabled, reports what the active seed roster observed. SPF, DKIM, DMARC, the works.
tour.marketing_voice_body: We train on your existing writing, then draft sequences in your actual voice. Fidelity-scored, regenerable, never robotic.
tour.marketing_pricing_title: Pricing scales with your list — not your guesswork.
tour.marketing_pricing_body: Sandbox is free. Launch is $39 monthly, Growth is $99, and Scale is $349. Every plan has a clear profile and sending allowance.
tour.marketing_cta_body: Free to start, free until you're sending real volume. The only question left is which import wizard you'd like first.
tour.dashboard_sidebar_body: Subscribers, campaigns, sequences, settings — one click away. The sidebar follows you everywhere.
tour.dashboard_onboarding_body: Import a list, check your sender health, ship a campaign. Most folks knock these out in under an hour.
tour.dashboard_api_body: Anything that talks to the API surfaces here. If something's off, you'll know before your subscribers do.
tour.dashboard_to_campaigns_body: This is where you'll spend most of your time. Click through and we'll keep going.
tour.dashboard_new_campaign_body: We've got AI subject suggestions, send-time optimization, and Inbox Reality baked into every send.
tour.dashboard_to_subscribers_body: Real people, real consent records, real-time segments. Let's take a look.
tour.dashboard_segments_body: They re-compute when subscribers change. No nightly batch, no stale audiences.
tour.dashboard_to_sequences_body: Fifty proven templates, every one rewritten in the way you actually write.
tour.dashboard_to_settings_body: Connect your sending domain here to get out of the spam folder for good.
tour.dashboard_finish_body: The little ? button in the corner replays this anytime. Cmd+/ opens it from any page. Now go ship something great.
